Tay Roc, whose real name is Donte Richardson, is an American battle rapper from Baltimore, Maryland.
He has been competing for nearly 20 years, with footage of him battling as a teenager available.
His career began with appearances in leagues like Fight Klub and Lionz Den, and he gained significant traction around 2014.
As of September 1, 2026, Tay Roc has 61 cataloged battles with over 98 million views, averaging over 1.6 million views per battle.
He has battled in numerous leagues, including KOTD (King of the Dot), URL (Ultimate Rap League), and others.
Some of his notable opponents include A Ward, K-Shine, Nu Jerzey Twork, Pat Stay, and Hollow Da Don.
Tay Roc was ranked #2 for Champion of the Year in 2017 and again in 2022.
In 2024, he was named Champion of the Year (COTY).
His activity and performance have been noted for their consistency and impact over the years, with a significant increase in battles and rankings from 2021 to 2024.
